title: Mexican Spiced Tofu with Walnut Guacamole & Bell Pepper-Corn Sauté

steps.text: Cut tofu into ½-inch thick slices along the short side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; place in a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper and set aside.
Place oil and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the spice oil.
Transfer tofu to another baking sheet and drizzle both sides with the spice oil. Place tofu in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until golden brown, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, cilantro, corn, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the veggies are cooking, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in the reserved bowl.
Juice one lime into the bowl with the shallot and garlic. (Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.)
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop the flesh into the bowl. Add spices and mash with a fork or potato masher until guacamole is smooth.
Roughly chop walnuts, add to the bowl with the guacamole, and stir to combine.
Divide tofu and veggies between plates; top tofu with guacamole and serve with lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
